method: Native-touch phone engineering fixtures. Angles, paused map state, static routes and actual movement rates measured. Receiver/spawn positions are explicitly arranged through the test handle; the held recovery is not a played mission.

checks: reviewer-size scene swipe turns at most125 degrees
paused map plots a capsule-clear path and offers native local zoom
manual MOVE overrides held approach and does not slow far movement
native approach and hold still require and complete the original recovery

failures.name: held USE near receiver caps walking; releasing restores ordinary speed
